1. Topic Title: Introduction to Hospitality Data
   Project: Gather and clean a real-world hospitality dataset (e.g., customer reviews, occupancy rates, etc.)

  2. Topic Title: Data Exploration and Visualization
   Project: Develop visualizations of the collected hospitality data and identify key insights

  3. Topic Title: Statistical Analysis for Hospitality Data
   Project: Conduct statistical analysis on the dataset to uncover patterns and relationships in the data

  4. Topic Title: Machine Learning Basics with Python
   Project: Build and evaluate a simple machine learning model (e.g., linear regression) to predict occupancy rates based on collected data

  5. Topic Title: Advanced Machine Learning Techniques for Hospitality Data
   Project: Experiment with more advanced machine learning models (e.g., decision trees, random forests, or neural networks) and their applications in hospitality analysis

  6. Topic Title: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting
   Project: Develop a time series model to forecast future trends in the collected hospitality data, such as occupancy rates or review scores

  7. Topic Title: Real-World Application of Machine Learning in Hospitality
   Project: Create a business proposal that leverages machine learning techniques to solve a real-world problem in the hospitality industry

  8. Topic Title: Job Preparation and Interview Skills for Data Analysts
   Project: Review industry-specific data analyst job postings, work on solving relevant interview problems, and prepare for successful interviews with potential employers
